say:1:1260013001:1.text: As the dust settles, Sonja clears her throat at the Sanctum Square in Rustport and addresses the long-awaiting crowd.
say:1:1260013001:1.source_cn: 一切尘埃落定，锈锚港的颂神广场上，索尼娅清了清嗓子，向...

say:3:1260013002:1.text: Good evening to all. I'm not one for long speeches, so I'll keep it short.
say:3:1260013002:1.source_cn: 各位，晚上好。我不擅长长篇大论，所以就简短地致辞。

say:4:1260013003:1.text: We have faced countless crises in the past—battles, deception, poverty, and violence... both external and internal.
say:4:1260013003:1.source_cn: 我们过去曾经经历过无数次的危机，战斗、欺骗、贫穷、暴力...

say:5:1260013004:1.text: That period of suffering and turmoil is likely still vivid in everyone's minds.
say:5:1260013004:1.source_cn: 那段痛苦而混乱的时光，对于大家而言，应该仍然记忆犹新。

say:6:1260013005:1.text: Yet, like cliffs that withstand the endless waves, Rustport, and we ourselves, will never yield.
say:6:1260013005:1.source_cn: 然而，就像永远不会被海浪侵蚀的崖岸一样，锈锚港，以及我...

say:7:1260013006:1.text: Today is the Fall Harvest, a holiday to celebrate and honor fallen heroes!
say:7:1260013006:1.source_cn: 今天是秋夜节，是庆祝丰收，纪念英灵的节日！

say:8:1260013007:1.text: In memory of our departed friends, in celebration of today's peace, and in anticipation of a bright future—
say:8:1260013007:1.source_cn: 为了怀念那些离去的伙伴，为了庆祝今日的安宁，为了迎接将...

say:9:1260013008:1.text:
Let us indulge in joy this night.
Let the Fall Harvest begin!
say:9:1260013008:1.source_cn: 今夜，尽情欢乐吧。\n秋夜节庆典，正式开始！！

say:10:1260013009:1.text: Following Sonja's speech, a vivid array of fireworks erupts in the night sky, with magnificent, glowing streams raining down, lighting up the dark ocean and the joyous crowd below...
say:10:1260013009:1.source_cn: 伴随着索尼娅的宣告，七彩缤纷的烟花在夜空中轰然炸开，辉...

say:11:1260013010:0.text: Fireworks... not bad, Hugin. You really managed to finish them in time.
say:11:1260013010:0.source_cn: 烟花……呼金，做得不错。竟然真的赶上节日开始了。

say:13:1260013011:1.text: Ha, it was easy! The materials were all prepared; I just mixed some old gunpowder with metal shavings and adjusted the ratio a few times.
say:13:1260013011:1.source_cn: 嚯哈哈，简单！材料都是现成的，把之前实验失败的火药掺入...

say:14:1260013012:1.text: It's been ages since I've seen fireworks, ever since Rustport was sealed. I daresay my work has turned out nicely.
say:14:1260013012:1.source_cn: 自从锈锚港封锁以来，好久没见到烟花了。不愧是我的作品，好看。

say:16:1260013013:1.text: "Nicely" doesn't do it justice! The fireworks are stunning! You've outdone yourself, Hugin!
say:16:1260013013:1.source_cn: 不是挺好看，是非常漂亮！绚丽！多彩！不愧是呼金大师！

say:17:1260013014:1.text: Flattery won't work on me... But alright, let's just set off all the remaining fireworks at once!
say:17:1260013014:1.source_cn: 就算拍马屁也没用……算了，我就不留了，所有的烟花现在一...

say:18:1260013015:1.text: More fireworks burst into the sky, and across Rustport's streets and alleys, people under the shapeshifting spell are busy exchanging freshly caught fish with each other.
say:18:1260013015:1.source_cn: 更多烟花在空中绽放，锈锚港大街小巷，都是被施加了幻形魔...

say:24:1260013017:1.text: Here, this is the fish I caught!

say:29:1260013019:1.text: If I didn't have to keep the peace, I'd have <style="stress"><player_name></style> cast a spell on me as well.
say:29:1260013019:1.source_cn: 如果不是为了维持秩序，我也想让<style=stres...
say:29:1260013019:1.male: If I didn't have to keep the peace, I'd have <style="stress"><player_name></style> cast a spell on me as well.
say:29:1260013019:1.female: If I didn't have to keep the peace, I'd have <style="stress"><player_name></style> cast a spell on me as well.

say:31:1260013021:1.text: This is the first festival since Rustport was liberated.
say:31:1260013021:1.source_cn: 因为这是锈锚港解放后，第一次过节。

say:32:1260013022:1.text: ...You're right. From today, we can say Rustport has reclaimed its own holiday.
say:32:1260013022:1.source_cn: ……你说得对。从今天开始，可以说我们锈锚港重拾了自己的节日。

say:35:1260013023:1.text: That's right! Unlike other places in the Lightbearer Empire, our shapeshifting relies on Merlin's magic, and we trade fish instead of sweets. Plus, there's a spectacular fireworks display!
say:35:1260013023:1.source_cn: 没错，跟耀光别的地方不一样，变装是靠梅林的魔法，交换的...

say:36:1260013024:1.text: This is what makes Rustpoirt truly unique!
say:36:1260013024:1.source_cn: 这正是专属于锈锚港独一无二的特色！

say:39:1260013025:1.text: Heh, when my adventures take me far and wide, the customs of Rustport will surely spread throughout Esperia.
say:39:1260013025:1.source_cn: 哼哼，等将来我的冒险脚步遍及整个大陆，锈锚港的风土人情...

say:40:1260013026:1.text: Then, who knows—people might travel just to enjoy Rustport's special Fall Harvest!
say:40:1260013026:1.source_cn: 到那时，说不定会有人专程来享受锈锚港特色的秋夜节！

say:41:1260013027:1.text: That's something worth looking forward to.

say:42:1260013028:1.text: Haha, you're finally smiling! That's the spirit—let's all enjoy ourselves!
say:42:1260013028:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，你也终于笑了！就是这样，大家一起开心点吧！

say:43:1260013029:1.text: Yeah, thank you. And thank you too, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, happy festival!
say:43:1260013029:1.male: Yeah, thank you. And thank you too, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, happy festival!
say:43:1260013029:1.female: Yeah, thank you. And thank you too, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, happy festival!
